Setup installs the independent ZeroTier service and virtual network driver
when the ZeroTier task is selected. Existing same/newer versions are retained.
Removing GameLink does not remove ZeroTier or its identity/network data.
No planet/moon files are imported or replaced by GameLink.

The following MPL 2.0 applies only to the independent ZeroTier components;
it does not relicense GameLink or the separately distributed Qt libraries.
